behaviour: RouteResolutionApiProxy tracks bootstrap vs finalized, lets callers subscribe to finalization, and fires its listeners once when finalization marks it.
rules: New private fields: `#finalized = false;` and `#finalizedListeners = new Set<() => void>();`.
`isFinalized()` returns `this.#finalized`.
`onFinalized(listener)`: when `#finalized` is true return a no-op function without registering; otherwise add the listener to the set and return a function that deletes it from the set.
`markFinalized()`: return at once when `#finalized` is true; otherwise set `#finalized = true`, copy the set into an array, clear the set, then call each listener in registration order.
`initialize()` and `resolve()` stay unchanged: initialize never finalizes, so the startup initialize from treeLifecycle.tsx leaves the proxy in bootstrap.
Add a one-line comment above `markFinalized` saying it is called by the finalization paths only, at most once in effect.
